description: CTAS behaviours: self-referential OR REPLACE, failure atomicity, type coercion of literals/aggregates (checked via information_schema), CLUSTER BY / COMMENT placement. Converted 1:1 from features/CtasSelfReplaceTest, CtasTypeCoercionTest and CtasWithClusterByTest (all now retired; the LocalDateTime instanceof assert became an information_schema data_type check).

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE roster (id INTEGER, label VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO roster VALUES (1, 'one'), (2, 'two')
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE roster (id INTEGER, label VARCHAR COLLATE 'en-ci') AS SELECT id, label FROM roster
SELECT COUNT(*), MAX(label) FROM roster

CREATE TABLE events (grp VARCHAR, happened_at TIMESTAMP_NTZ(9), amount NUMBER)
CREATE TABLE expected_events AS SELECT grp, happened_at FROM events WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT 'g', '2024-10-17 18:06:28.071'
SELECT data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'EXPECTED_EVENTS' AND column_name = 'HAPPENED_AT'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT grp, happened_at FROM expected_events EXCEPT SELECT grp, happened_at FROM events)
CREATE TABLE events (grp VARCHAR, happened_at TIMESTAMP_NTZ(9), amount NUMBER)
CREATE TABLE latest_events AS SELECT grp, MAX(happened_at) AS happened_at FROM events GROUP BY grp
SELECT data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'LATEST_EVENTS' AND column_name = 'HAPPENED_AT'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM events s INNER JOIN latest_events l ON l.grp = s.grp AND l.happened_at = s.happened_at
CREATE TABLE events (grp VARCHAR, happened_at TIMESTAMP_NTZ(9), amount NUMBER)
CREATE TABLE totals AS SELECT grp, SUM(amount) AS total FROM events GROUP BY grp
